messages:
Riley: Heads-up team — running an ownership tidy & playbook quiesce tomorrow 08:00 PT. Goal: reconcile accounts with no owner but recent activity, fix stale owner_shadows, and temporarily suppress owner-notify playbooks for the affected owners. Dry-run 200 accounts first. ETA ~40m.
Samir: Will this reassign owners automatically? We need an audit trail.
Riley: Yes — auto-assign to a fallback_owner (based on region/segment) only if owner IS NULL and account_activity_last_30d > 0. We'll snapshot before writes. No overwrites if owner_locked = true.
Olga: Paste the selection query and the reassign logic so I can review.
Riley: Query & logic (preview):
```sql
-- candidates: active accounts without owner but recent activity
SELECT account_id, region, segment, last_activity_at
FROM accounts
WHERE owner_id IS NULL
  AND account_status = 'active'
  AND last_activity_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
LIMIT 200;
```
Pseudocode for assign: 
- fallback_owner = owners_lookup(region, segment)
- if fallback_owner IS NOT NULL AND owner_locked = false THEN set owner_id = fallback_owner, add tag 'owner:autofill-3612345678'
- snapshot rows to cs_admin.backups.owner_tidy_3612345678 before update
```
Nate: Playbook suppression plan? We should avoid silencing billing or security runbooks.
Riley: We'll set owner-scoped flag `suppress_playbooks = ['owner_notify']` for owners receiving many autofills; runner respects this flag and critical playbooks bypass it. Window 08:00-09:00 PT.
ops-bot: Task created  CS-12021 "ownership-tidy + owner_notify quiesce" assigned to Riley. Dry-run id dr-3612345678.
Samir: Rollback plan? If assignments are wrong we must revert quickly and notify owners.
Riley: Rollback: restore from cs_admin.backups.owner_tidy_3612345678 and send a bulk email to affected owners summarizing changes (template in cs-admin/templates/owner_tidy_3612345678.md). We'll also upload changed_ids CSV to admin-s3/owner-tidy/3612345678.csv.
Olga: Add guard: skip accounts where opt_out_owner_changes = true OR is_test_account = true. Also do not touch accounts with manual_owner_notes present.
Nate: I'll watch metrics: owner_assign_rate, playbook_fire_rate (owner_notify), webhook_queue, and support tickets tagged 'owner_mismatch'. If >50 changes/min or playbook spike, I'll trigger rollback.
Riley: Plan: dry-run 08:00-08:08, owner batches 08:08-08:45, verification 08:45-09:00. I'll post sample diff after dry-run. :white_check_mark:
Samir: lgtm — thanks for adding snapshots and owner-scoped suppression.
Riley: Kicking off dry-run in ~10m, will paste sample output when ready.
